title: The Mist Breath Primer
summary: A primer on breathing a thin cool haze from the lungs and wearing it as a first cover.

title: Primer of the Low Fog
summary: A primer on gathering a low fog about the feet and using it to slip and to blur.

title: A Handbook of Soft Vapor
summary: A handbook of vapor that softens a blow and hides the hand that threw it.

title: The Dew and Haze Course
summary: A course in beading dew on the skin and spreading haze round it so that touch slides and sight fails.

title: Plain Guide to Fading from View
summary: A plain guide to letting the edges of the body go soft and grey until the eye slides over them.

title: The Drifting Step Drill
summary: A drill in moving like a slow cloud of mist so that each step arrives where the foe is not looking.
